concept: What makes a number rational: Decimals that stay rational
artifact:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 300">
  <text x="200" y="26" text-anchor="middle" class="title">Which decimals are rational?</text>
  <text x="200" y="44" text-anchor="middle" class="small">rational = can be written as p/q</text>

  
  <rect x="24" y="60" width="160" height="180" rx="6" />
  <text x="104" y="82" text-anchor="middle" class="head">Terminating</text>
  <line x1="34" y1="90" x2="174" y2="90" />
  <text x="104" y="112" text-anchor="middle" class="lbl">0.5</text>
  <text x="104" y="134" text-anchor="middle" class="lbl">0.75</text>
  <text x="104" y="156" text-anchor="middle" class="lbl">3.125</text>
  <text x="104" y="186" text-anchor="middle" class="small">ends after few digits</text>
  <text x="104" y="212" text-anchor="middle" class="lbl">0.75 = 3/4</text>
  <path d="M60 224 L148 224" class="tick" />
  <text x="104" y="236" text-anchor="middle" class="small">✓ rational</text>

  
  <rect x="216" y="60" width="160" height="180" rx="6" />
  <text x="296" y="82" text-anchor="middle" class="head">Repeating</text>
  <line x1="226" y1="90" x2="366" y2="90" />
  <text x="296" y="112" text-anchor="middle" class="lbl">0.333…</text>
  <text x="296" y="134" text-anchor="middle" class="lbl">0.1666…</text>
  <text x="296" y="156" text-anchor="middle" class="lbl">0.142857…</text>
  <line x1="278" y1="102" x2="288" y2="102" class="tick" />
  <text x="296" y="186" text-anchor="middle" class="small">a block repeats forever</text>
  <text x="296" y="212" text-anchor="middle" class="lbl">0.333… = 1/3</text>
  <path d="M252 224 L340 224" class="tick" />
  <text x="296" y="236" text-anchor="middle" class="small">✓ rational</text>

  
  <text x="200" y="266" text-anchor="middle" class="small">Non-terminating & non-repeating (e.g. 0.101001000…)</text>
  <text x="200" y="282" text-anchor="middle" class="small">→ NOT rational (irrational)</text>
</svg>
